dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000sxqf](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000sxqf) Magnitude 6.2 earthquake at 146.066 depth occurred on May 14 2026 271 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -6.198 longitude 130.3702. It impacted 357 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
